_comment: L3 counterfactual scan (design doc §六 L3): the same L3_cta checkpoint decoded at the truth CTA shifted by ±30 / ±60 / ±90 s (predict-only; run AFTER l3_cta_20260907 has trained). Reading, per offset and per stratum: predicted_final_time error == offset (by construction; a deviation is a bug), per-sample flyability rate vs the CTA=0 arm, chamfer / path-length ratio / lateral corridor and vertical-window compliance as a function of |offset| — smooth is the gate, a collapse (straight-line or looping paths at ±90 s) is the failure. These records are counterfactuals, never accuracy results.
